label: oil_pressure
meaning: Oil level too low or oil pump failure
driver_action: Pull over safely and switch off; check oil level; do not drive on
caveat: Some cars show this amber for low level

label: coolant_temperature
driver_action: Pull over and switch off; do not open a hot radiator cap

label: brake_system
meaning: Low brake fluid / handbrake on / pad wear sensor
driver_action: Check handbrake; if still lit stop and call for help

label: battery_charging
what_the_camera_sees: Battery symbol lit while engine runs
driver_action: Car runs on battery only — drive straight to a workshop or stop
caveat: May stall when battery is flat

label: airbag_srs
what_the_camera_sees: Seated person with airbag circle lit
meaning: Airbag system fault — may not deploy

label: check_engine_flashing
meaning: Serious misfire that can damage the catalyst
caveat: Flashing is more serious than steady

label: abs
meaning: Anti-lock braking offline (normal brakes still work)

label: traction_esp
meaning: Stability control fault or switched off

label: tyre_pressure
meaning: One or more tyres about 20–25% under-inflated
driver_action: Inflate at the next station; check for puncture

label: ev_reduced_power
meaning: EV/hybrid limp-home: low battery or overheating
driver_action: Drive gently to a charger or dealer

label: ev_battery_temperature
meaning: Traction battery too hot or cold
driver_action: Avoid DC fast charging; dealer check if it persists

label: coolant
what_the_camera_sees: Puddle under the radiator / front engine area
driver_action: Check coolant level; watch the temperature gauge; fix promptly to avoid overheating
caveat: Pink/red coolant overlaps with transmission fluid colour — use location

label: transmission_fluid
what_the_camera_sees: Puddle under the gearbox (middle of car)

label: power_steering_fluid
what_the_camera_sees: Puddle near the front wheels / steering rack

label: engine_oil
what_the_camera_sees: Puddle under the engine (oil pan / valve cover / sump plug)

label: brake_fluid
what_the_camera_sees: Wet patch near a wheel or under the pedal area
caveat: Hard to separate from oil by colour only — ask about location and smell

label: washer_fluid
what_the_camera_sees: Drip near the front of the car

label: ac_condensate
what_the_camera_sees: Drip near the front passenger footwell area

label: white_thin_cold_start
what_the_camera_sees: Thin vapour that disappears after warm-up

label: white_thick_persistent
meaning: Coolant entering the engine (e.g. failed head gasket)
driver_action: Stop and check coolant; risk of engine failure

label: blue
meaning: Engine burning oil (valve seals / piston rings / turbo)

label: grey
meaning: Oil burning / faulty PCV valve / transmission fluid leak (automatic)
driver_action: Professional inspection; urgent if transmission fluid

label: black
meaning: Petrol: too much fuel (air filter / injectors); diesel: soot / DPF
driver_action: Check the air filter first; injectors at a workshop
